node.statement: For every j, P_j=w(e_j) is a t-projection: the projection identity e_j^2=e_j and the t-multiplicative-defect bound for w give ||P_j^2-P_j||<=t, while the self-adjointness clause for the inclusion gives the required Hermitian condition. Since t<=e_zero<=e_sim, lem-maincb-corner-equivalence applies and makes j~k iff dim S^A_{P_j,P_k}=1 an equivalence relation.
